title: Obadiah — Instructions and Commands
content:
Obadiah — Instructions and Commands

Instructions · All Old Testament books · Original Torah and New Testament index

3 additional passage records · 4 quoted verse units. Read Obadiah in Saints Translation.

This is a working instruction register organized by topic and then classification. Open a passage for its exact wording, source link and context note. Historical orders and rhetorical or poetic addresses retain their original setting; their presence here does not make them universal laws.

Review status: Working catalogue: the source collection covers every Old Testament book currently in Saints.Bible. Individual commands, repeated formulations, speakers and Christian application still require further review; this is not a certified exhaustive count of laws.

Topics: Faith, repentance and allegiance · Family, marriage and household · Historical commissions, journeys and public life

Faith, repentance and allegiance

Uncertain · 1 passage records

Obadiah 1:1

Record type: Prophetic instruction or reported speech. Source section: The Vision of Obadiah Against Idumea.

Obadiah 1:1 — The vision of Obadiah. Thus says the Lord God to Idumea: I heard a report from the Lord, and He sent a dispatch to the nations: “Rise up! Let us rise against her for battle!”

Context and scope: Distinguish the prophet’s commission, covenant exhortation, quoted human speech and judgment rhetoric. Application beyond the original addressee remains open unless evidence is supplied.

Obadiah 1:12

Record type: Prophetic instruction or reported speech. Source section: Because of the Slaughter of Your Brother Jacob.

Obadiah 1:12 — Do not look on your brother’s day, on the day of strangers; do not rejoice over the sons of Judah on the day of their destruction; do not speak boastfully on the day of affliction.

Historical commissions, journeys and public life

Obadiah 1:13 – Obadiah 1:14

Record type: Prophetic instruction or reported speech. Source section: Because of the Slaughter of Your Brother Jacob.

Obadiah 1:13 — Do not enter the gates of peoples on the day of their suffering. You, too, must not look on their assembly on the day of their destruction, and do not join in attacking their strength on the day of their destruction.

Obadiah 1:14 — Do not stand at their escape routes to destroy those of them who are being saved, and do not shut in those fleeing from them on the day of affliction.
